name: SikaRoof VersiDrain P-Anchor
paste:
SIKAROOF® VERSIDRAIN® P-ANCHOR®: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor®, June 2026, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sikaroof-versidrainp-anchor.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® is a lightweight under screed drainage mat installed between the structural slab and the covering screed, or between hardscape finishes. Modules are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it allows entrapped water in the finishes’ cement screed to drain away through the perforations in the mat.
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® modules interlock with adjacent modules for easy installation and has a smooth base for safe placement directly over the waterproofing membrane. The frusto-pyramidal openings allow the screed that is poured onto SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® to flow through and bind to the substrate below, eliminating a floating slab.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Under screed drainage mat for podiums, balconies, rooftops and areas with hardscape finishes requiring mitigation efforts against efflorescence by allowing entrapped moisture to escape.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor®
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: UNDER SCREED DRAINAGE MAT FOR EFFLORESCENCE MITIGATION
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D695-15: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Perforations to drain moisture within the screed
    - Drainage channel to facilitate water flow
    - Trays interlock adjacently for uniform coverage
    - Smooth base protects underlying waterproofing membrane
    - Frusto-pyramidal openings for bonding to structure
    - Cut to size for odd shaped layouts
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Black dimpled perforated square modules
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: 500 x 500 x 6 mm
    - Weight: 1.8 kg/m²
    - Pull-out resistance: Pull out resistance to concrete; 4 kN/m²
    - Service temperature: -30 °C to 80 °C
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | Unbonded | Bonded (Gr20 c/s screed) |
    | 800 kN/m² | 15,000 kN/m² |
    Test method printed: (ASTM D695-15)
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® : 20 pieces / bundle
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet
2.9 Storage conditions. Bundles must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 02.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the drainage module.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® shall be loosely laid and interlocked with adjacent modules connected by proprietary in-built clips to form a continuous drainage layer without any mechanical fixing either on top of the waterproofing membrane or on top of the concrete surface. For a bonded application, the cement & sand screed shall be poured onto the drainage modules to receive tile finishes. For an unbonded application, insulation boards shall be installed on the drainage modules before applying tile adhesive and finishes.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor® is not resistant to permanent weathering and UV exposure.
    - When used in combination with Sarnafil® or SikaPlan® membranes, a separation/protection layer is recommended.
    For more information, please contact Sika Sales Personnel.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2026, Version 02.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: Unbonded | Bonded (Gr20 c/s screed); 800 kN/m² | 15,000 kN/m² (ASTM D695-15)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® P-Anchor®, June 2026, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sikaroof-versidrainp-anchor.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
